title: Roadmap
bevyReworkNote: A parallel build that will replace the alpha version
textRewrite: Complete text rewrite and manual check
textRewriteNote: AI generated text banks replaced with handwritten ones. This will take a long time, given the sheer amount of text banks already in the game
ggufModelsNote: Long term goal: a local text model controlling the simulation as its director
balancingNote: Enemy levels rise with distance from the Omega Tower, loot follows the party's level, and armour, weapons and betting odds come from generators checked by balance tests. Long term goal: gather player experience to balance it even further
skyscraperInteriorsNote: Lobbies and floors are laid out. Long term goal: populate them
shopInteriorsNote: All the basic shop types are defined. Long term goal: more variation and new shop types
patronContentNote: Patreon stars and vaults are in, and the vaults will be unlocked in story mode for non patrons. Long term goal: more exclusive Patreon locations
selectFeature: Select a system to see what is done.

core: Worlds that run for centuries, every savegame reading the same living history
An original soundtrack composed by the developer for the whole game
combat: Every class, skill and enemy balanced across the whole level range
Large battles mixing the party, armies and summons on one field
npcs: Whole cities of people who remember the party and shape each other's lives
Generated characters with stories as deep as the written ones
economy: A continental economy where prices follow supply, wars and harvests
vehicles: Trains, ships and aircraft to live and work aboard
hypernet: A Hypernet of hundreds of sites written by the world's own people and factions
Networks between HyperDecks, with hacking and shared files
galaxy: Colonies and stations that trade, grow and fight among the stars
Every landable world with its own life, settlements and quests
Advanced space colonization as the endgame, settling and shaping whole worlds
health: Hospitals, doctors and surgery run by NPCs
Mind, ageing and old wounds weighing on the party for life
crafting: Homes and bases built block by block, on the map and in the 3D world
Farms and workshops large enough to supply a whole town
cards: Leagues and tournaments for every game, with NPC champions
Every minigame playable against other players
world: A main story with several endings, from the first square to the top of the Omega Tower
Every European country with its own landmarks, traditions and quest chains
92 world maps, one for each dimension the Omega Tower pierces, each reached from its own floor, with the tower as the hub between worlds
Each biome populated with thousands of handcrafted prefabs and map pieces
multiplayer: Shared persistent worlds where parties meet, trade and fight
The whole story playable together by up to eight players
